daily_adjusted_bars.source: Yahoo adjusted OHLCV; current-stock cache is not a historical universe

second_bars.sampling: selected ORB entry/stop minutes, not full-market or full-session coverage

absence_scope: No dedicated source module or dataset found in repository/data inventory. ETF exposures and downloaded research HTML are not underlying contract histories.

storage_planning.estimate_caveat: Extrapolation from local compressed cache; historical volume can differ
storage_planning.point_in_time_backfill: Older bars require separate historical month-end caps/CIKs, split coverage, and identifier/delisting validation; they do not extend current PIT data by themselves
